items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: all the trumpet players I don’t care who you are to this day should be hanging out with Jon Faddis to get the Dizzy Gillespie system.

ctx.x: That’s how you get better. You never stop growing, you never stop listening, you never stop learning. You know like I was thinking about the trumpet players. I said they can listen to anybody but the one trumpet player, say other than say Clark, Joe Wilder or Snooky, all the trumpet players I don’t care who you are to this day should be hanging out with Jon Faddis to get the Dizzy Gillespie system. See that’s who they should be checking out. Jon Faddis. Because for me Dizzy still, if there is a king on the…
Well you did the thing with Miles.
